data.name: Fresco Original
data.shortDescription: Engineered for the discerning coffee devotee, the single-serve espresso unit merges modern elegance with artisanal precision for an effortlessly exquisite brew.
data.description: The single-serve espresso machine is a perfect addition to any coffee lover's kitchen, offering convenience and quality in one compact design. It features a detachable reservoir, making it easy to fill with water and clean, ensuring that your espresso is always brewed with fresh water. The machine also includes a drip dish that can be removed for effortless cleaning, preventing any mess on your countertop. With its sleek and modern design, this espresso machine not only delivers delicious, barista-quality espresso shots but also adds a touch of elegance to your kitchen decor. Whether you're in a rush in the morning or enjoying a leisurely afternoon coffee break, this single-serve espresso machine provides a quick and easy way to enjoy your favorite espresso drinks.
